# Haiti

> [!summary] Data available
> Food coverage is minimal ([[WorldCuisines]] 11 dishes, [[FmLAMA]] 5) but traditional plant use is large: [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]] has 2,541 Haitian ethnobotany records (571 taxa), the most for any Latin American country after Mexico. No FCT.

## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]] 11 dishes (1 Haiti-only; the rest shared Caribbean, e.g. rice and peas); [[FmLAMA]] 5 dishes (griot, diri ak djon djon, tonmtonm, kasav, bouillon).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national food composition table in the vault or `Backlog/`; [[USDA FoodData Central]] is the fallback.
- Plants: [[CMAUP]] 138 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 2,541 ethnobotany records, 571 taxa. [[KNApSAcK Family]] has a World-map page for it (edible/medicinal species records), not scraped, so no count in the vault.
- Compound → effect chains via the [[Global]] backbones ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]]).

## Gaps
- No Haitian recipe set and no Kreyòl food knowledge.
- No FCT.
